about: Notes with known right answers for what processing may put in the Review queue. Every name, number and address is made up. test/suggestion-cases.test.mjs runs each case with the model answers recorded here; scripts/suggestion-cases.mjs runs them with a live model and records new answers. expect: known = suggestions that repeat something the notebook already holds, repeats = suggestions that repeat another queued one, then counts of facts about the owner, timeline entries and new people; a number is exact, {max} or {min} a bound.
